newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 2.31 pct down on short-selling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 2.31 pct down on short-selling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 2.31 percent down on Thursday as blue chips tumbled amid heavy short-selling by speculators and brokers said they saw little prospect for the index to recover in the near term.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 31.98 points to end at 1,354.28. Losers beat gainers 195 to 46.

"Trading volumes have picked up on speculative activity," dealer Ather Raouf said. "There is no support from institutions and key scrips, including PTCL and Hub Power, eased on short selling." Engro Chemicals fell 3.0 rupees to 136 and Fauji Fertilizer 2.85 to 66. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
